additional_info.subject: Notes to RC
additional_info.body: Following the discussion held with Giridhar and yourself regarding this matter, it has been agreed that the cable may be replaced to address the issue.

Hello,
Since we are experiencing initial problems with outlet 1, I would recommend replacing both cables simultaneously. This approach would be more efficient as it would:
Avoid multiple site visits
Save time by performing cable recalibrations in a single session
Be more cost-effective in terms of service deployment
